import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    
    static class Edge {
        int v, rev;
        long flow, cap, cost;
        Edge(int v, int rev, long flow, long cap, long cost) {
            this.v = v;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }
    
    static class Flow {
        static final int N = 50 * T + 2;
        static List<Edge>[] graph;
        static int[] deg;
        static long minCost;
        
        static void reset(int n) {
            minCost = 0;
            deg = new int[n];
            graph = new List[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        
        static void connect(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
            minCost = Math.max(minCost, cap);
            graph[u].add(new Edge(v, deg[v]++, 0, cap, cost));
            graph[v].add(new Edge(u, deg[u]++, 0, 0, -cost));
        }
        
        static boolean[] visited;
        static int[] parent;
        static long[] potential;
        static long[] dist;
        
        static void setupPotential(int n) {
            potential = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(potential, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            potential[0] = 0;
            for (int step = 1; step < n; step++) {
                for (int node = 0; node < n; node++) {
                    if (potential[node] == Long.MAX_VALUE) continue;
                    for (Edge e : graph[node]) {
                        if (e.cap > 0) {
                            potential[e.v] = Math.min(potential[e.v], potential[node] + e.cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        static long augment(int src, int dst, long[] totalCost, int nodes, boolean useQueue) {
            visited = new boolean[nodes];
            dist = new long[nodes];
            parent = new int[nodes];
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[src] = 0;
            
            if (useQueue) {
                Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                q.offer(src);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = q.poll();
                    if (visited[u]) continue;
                    visited[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                        if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.v] + e.cost) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.v] + e.cost;
                            parent[e.v] = e.rev;
                            q.offer(e.v);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int u = src; u != -1; ) {
                    visited[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                        if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.v] + e.cost) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.v] + e.cost;
                            parent[e.v] = e.rev;
                        }
                    }
                    u = -1;
                    long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) {
                        if (!visited[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                            best = dist[u = i];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (dist[dst] >= Long.MAX_VALUE) return 0;
            
            long bottleneck = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int node = dst; node != src; ) {
                Edge revEdge = graph[node].get(parent[node]);
                Edge forwardEdge = graph[revEdge.v].get(revEdge.rev);
                bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, forwardEdge.cap - forwardEdge.flow);
                node = revEdge.v;
            }
            
            for (int node = dst; node != src; ) {
                Edge revEdge = graph[node].get(parent[node]);
                Edge forwardEdge = graph[revEdge.v].get(revEdge.rev);
                forwardEdge.flow += bottleneck;
                revEdge.flow -= bottleneck;
                totalCost[0] += bottleneck * forwardEdge.cost;
                node = revEdge.v;
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) {
                if (dist[i] < Long.MAX_VALUE) {
                    potential[i] = Math.min(Long.MAX_VALUE, dist[i] + potential[i]);
                }
            }
            return bottleneck;
        }
        
        static long minCostMaxFlow(int src, int dst, long[] totalCost, int nodes, boolean useQueue) {
            setupPotential(nodes);
            long totalFlow = 0;
            totalCost[0] = 0;
            while (true) {
                long df = augment(src, dst, totalCost, nodes, useQueue);
                if (df == 0) break;
                totalFlow += df;
            }
            return totalFlow;
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        final int source = 0;
        final int sink = n * T + 1;
        
        Flow.reset(sink + 1);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            Flow.connect(source, a, 1, 0);
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            Flow.connect(1 + t * n, sink, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.connect(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, Long.MAX_VALUE, c);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    Flow.connect(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    Flow.connect(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }
        
        long[] totalCost = new long[1];
        long flow = Flow.minCostMaxFlow(source, sink, totalCost, sink + 1, true);
        
        System.out.println(totalCost[0]);
    }
}
